findings.expected: A cancelled gesture on A must not override the later keyboard activation of B; closing B returns to B.

findings.cause: pointerOpener is recorded on pointerdown and remains after a cancelled click. rememberOpener prefers it to active/outside focus; no keyboard invalidation runs before the !modal early return.
